Storage & Baseline Controls

Reset UCAM Baseline
Clears UCAM item snapshot cache. Next scan will rebuild baseline without alerting.
Reset eLMS Baseline
Clears eLMS item snapshot cache. Next scan will rebuild baseline without alerting.
Clear Local Database
Removes all stored notifications, item records, and scan history from IndexedDB.
